documentation.text:
@dev Updates the risk score for a specific user. 
 Usually called by the backend security engine.
@dev Adjusts the LTV ratio for a token dynamically.

@dev Returns if a user is allowed to perform a high-risk action.
 Restrictions apply if risk score is high or emergency mode is on.
@dev Returns the effective LTV for a token, considering dynamic adjustments.

devdoc.details: Autonomous security controller for the DeFi protocol. Handles risk scores, dynamic collateral ratios, and emergency modes.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

adjustCollateralRatio(address,uint256).details: Adjusts the LTV ratio for a token dynamically.

getEffectiveLTV(address,uint256).details: Returns the effective LTV for a token, considering dynamic adjustments.

isActionAllowed(address).details: Returns if a user is allowed to perform a high-risk action. Restrictions apply if risk score is high or emergency mode is on.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateRiskScore(address,uint256).details: Updates the risk score for a specific user.  Usually called by the backend security engine.

devdoc.title: RiskController
